full_script: [cheerful] Frases para la vida real. Tú primero, luego yo. I'm here to pick up my prescription. Do you have anything for the flu? I have a sore throat. Does this make you drowsy? Should I take it with food? Is there a generic version? Does my insurance cover it? I need something for the pain. Is it safe for kids? Where are the vitamins? [excited] Guárdalo para cuando lo necesites y dime cuántas sabías.
